The '''Lonjair Prime system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Danjar sector/Legends|Danjar sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Lonjair]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CNII" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lonjair Prime system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square M-19.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
